hints.invalid_url: HTTP, HTTPS and FTP links, magnet links and torrent files are supported.
hints.unsupported: HTTP, HTTPS and FTP links, magnet links and torrent files are supported.
hints.network: Check your connection and the proxy in Settings › Network, then retry.
hints.timeout: The server did not answer. Retry later, or raise the timeouts in Settings › Network.
hints.tls: Check the system date and time. A proxy or security software may also have replaced the certificate.
hints.http_status: The server has a temporary problem. Retry later.
hints.ftp_reply: The server may limit simultaneous logins. Lower the FTP sessions in Settings › Network and retry.
hints.not_found: The link may have expired. Get a new download link from the original page.
hints.auth_required: Start the download from your browser again so your sign-in comes along; for FTP, put the account in the link.
hints.forbidden: The link may have expired, or only works from the original page. Start the download from your browser again.
hints.remote_changed: What was downloaded no longer matches the new file. Choose Download again to start over.
hints.file_missing: The torrent file this download was added from can no longer be read. Add the torrent again, or use its magnet link.
hints.disk_full: Free up space, then choose Retry. What was downloaded is kept.
hints.io: Check that the save location still exists and can be written to (is the external or network drive connected?), then retry.
hints.internal: Retry once. If it happens again, report it with the logs (Settings › General › Logs).

torrent.dhtHint: Finds peers when there is no Tracker; most magnet links need it. Takes effect after restarting the app
torrent.upnpHint: Asks the router to forward the listening port so more peers can connect. Takes effect after restarting the app
